Card Q&A.q: If both this Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and an opponent's Digimon are deleted at the same time, will this card's inherited effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, if this Digimon has [Greymon] in its name, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
